⚡ Zest v0.9.0 — Easy Static-site Toolkit
     Ecosystem: .zest.fsx + .ztk + .zcss

  USAGE
    zest <command> [options]

  COMMANDS
    build [path]                Build the site into _site/
    serve [options]             Build and start the dev server with live reload
    preview [options]           Serve _site/ without rebuilding
    init [path]                 Scaffold a new site
    clean [path]                Remove build output
    help                        Show this help message

  OPTIONS
    -p, --port <port>           Server port (default: 8080)
    -w, --watch                 Watch files and rebuild on change
    -v, --verbose               Enable debug-level logging
    -q, --quiet                 Suppress info-level output
    --empty                     Scaffold without starter content (zest init)
    -h, --help                  Show help
    --version                   Show the version

  Run 'zest <command> --help' for command-specific options.

result.stdout:
Usage
  zest build [path] [options]


  Options
  path              Project directory (default: current directory)
  --watch, -w       Watch for changes and auto-rebuild
  --no-incremental  Rebuild every page, ignoring the incremental cache
  --verbose, -v     Enable Debug-level logging
  --quiet, -q       Suppress Info-level logs
  Hooks             _prebuild.fsx runs before the build, _finalize.fsx after it

Usage
  zest serve [options]


  Options
  --port, -p PORT   Dev server port (default: 8080)
  --host HOST       Bind to host (default: localhost; use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)
  --open, -o        Open browser on start
  --spa             Fall back to index.html for every route
  --dir             Enable directory listing
  --verbose, -v     Show detailed FSI output
  --quiet, -q       Suppress Info-level logs
  Hooks             _prebuild.fsx and _finalize.fsx run on every rebuild
